name: Palladian Construction
full_legal_name: Palladian Construction & Urban Reclamation Sovereignty, Ltd-S
sector: Megastructure Construction, Urban Demolition, & Territorial Reclamation
sovereign_territory: Palladian Prime — a sovereign industrial zone in the ruins of Gary, Indiana, housing the corponation's primary fabrication yards, materials processing facilities, and the infamous Palladian Detention Architecture (pre-fabricated sovereign holding structures leased to other corponations). Additionally claims 'construction sovereignty' over any active build site exceeding 10,000 square meters anywhere in the corridor.
founding_story: Palladian was built on a legal innovation as much as a physical one. In 2139, structural engineer and legal theorist Dr. Constance Mura published a landmark paper arguing that the act of construction — the physical transformation of territory — constituted a form of sovereign claim under emerging Corporate Reclamation Law. She then immediately founded Palladian to test her thesis in practice. Acquiring the ruins of Gary, Indiana as her base of operations, Mura developed a construction methodology called 'Territorial Metabolism' — a continuous cycle of demolition, material reclamation, and reconstruction that allowed Palladian to extract value from urban collapse while simultaneously building new corporate infrastructure. The corponation grew explosively during the GLMZ expansion boom of the 2040s, becoming the primary contractor for megastructure construction across the corridor. Mura's legal argument was eventually upheld in the 2147 Corridor Corporate Court ruling 'Palladian v. Detroit Municipal Remnant,' establishing construction sovereignty as a recognized legal category. Dr. Mura now serves as both CEO and Chief Legal Sovereign of the corponation.
security_force: The Foundation — a 15,000-person construction-site security and urban warfare unit equipped with industrial exoskeletons, demolition drone swarms, and mobile fabrication units capable of erecting defensive fortifications in under six hours. The Foundation is notorious for its use of 'structural denial' — the deliberate demolition of infrastructure to reshape battlefield terrain.
key_detail: Palladian's Detention Architecture division — a side business leasing pre-fabricated sovereign holding facilities to other corponations — generates Φ18 billion annually and has made Palladian the primary provider of private incarceration infrastructure in the corridor. The holding structures are technically Palladian sovereign territory, meaning detainees held within them fall under Palladian rather than corridor jurisdiction.
relationship_to_big_20: Ranked 11th in the Big 20. Palladian's relationships with other Big 20 members are almost entirely transactional — it has built facilities for nearly all of them and holds construction debt leverage over several. Its Detention Architecture business creates an additional layer of complicated dependency with corponations that use its holding facilities.
full_text: PALLADIAN CONSTRUCTION & URBAN RECLAMATION SOVEREIGNTY, LTD-S — stock designation PCS-L — is the dominant megastructure construction and urban reclamation corponation of the GLMZ corridor, responsible for an estimated 58% of all major construction projects completed in the megacity since 2140. Founded by structural engineer and legal theorist Dr. Constance Mura on the ruins of Gary, Indiana, Palladian built its empire on the twin pillars of Mura's Territorial Metabolism construction philosophy and her landmark legal argument that construction constitutes sovereign territorial claim — a thesis upheld by the Corridor Corporate Court in 2147 and now a foundational principle of corridor property law. Operating from Palladian Prime, its sovereign industrial zone in Gary, the corponation maintains fabrication yards, materials processing facilities, and the infrastructure to deploy construction teams of up to 50,000 workers to any corridor location within 72 hours. Palladian's bonded labor force of 1.4 million workers — recruited predominantly from the corridor's displaced urban populations — forms the human machinery of this construction capacity, operating under work contracts that critics compare unfavorably to Ironclad's Nutrition Work Covenant. The corponation's security arm, The Foundation, enforces construction sovereignty through industrial-scale urban warfare capability, including the distinctive 'structural denial' tactic of deliberate demolition as a tactical tool. A significant and controversial revenue stream comes from Palladian's Detention Architecture division, which leases pre-fabricated sovereign holding structures to other corponations — structures that, by virtue of being Palladian-sovereign territory, operate outside corridor legal jurisdiction. Valued at Φ1.4 trillion with annual revenues of Φ290 billion and a direct workforce of 210,000, Palladian ranks 11th in the Big 20 and maintains leverage over much of the corridor's corporate landscape through construction debt and the quiet power of knowing exactly where the load-bearing walls are.

glmzTerritory.description: Palladian Prime — sovereign industrial zone in the Gary, Indiana ruins and extending into Zone 11's southern wrap. Materials warehousing, fabrication facilities, and the largest crane fleet in the Corridor. Palladian built most of the GLMZ's corponation facilities during the 2150-2190 construction surge and retained the territory they built on.
glmzTerritory.grayZoneRelationship: Palladian's Gary territory borders some of Zone 6's most dangerous Gray Zones. They maintain a private security force of 2,400 personnel specifically for perimeter enforcement.
